name: TTS
description: A deep learning toolkit for text-to-speech, battle-tested in research and production.
one_liner: Turn written text into natural-sounding speech, and even clone a specific voice from a short sample.
buyer: Course creators and small publishers who want audio versions of their content without paying a narrator every time they edit a line.
business_use_cases: An online course platform auto-generates an audio track for every lesson so students can listen on a commute.
A local news site offers a 'listen to this article' button in the founder's own cloned voice.
A children's book app reads stories aloud in a consistent, friendly character voice.

money_ideas.idea: Sell 'audiobook-in-a-day' for self-published authors: they upload a manuscript, get a narrated file back.
A subscription that keeps a creator's cloned voice on file and re-narrates whenever they update content.

steal_this: Build a tiny web app where a Shopify store owner records 30 seconds once, then every new product description is auto-narrated in their voice for the store video.
